 Community Watchlist Portfolio Search stocks, sectors, indices or pages News Energy Quick read Petrol price cut by Rs3 per litre, diesel rate unchanged
 Mettis Global • 18 Nov 2026, 7:24 AM PKT • 1 min read 
 ENG اردو A- A+ Add as preferred source on Google X f Mettis Global reported that OGRA’s latest fuel-price revision takes effect on November 18, 2026, with petrol down Rs3.00 per litre and High-Speed Diesel (HSD) unchanged. The new ex-depot petrol rate is Rs325.00 per litre, compared with Rs328.00 previously; HSD remains at Rs358.00 per litre.
 The adjustment was made under the petroleum-pricing framework approved by the federal government, according to the report. With diesel’s rate held steady and petrol reduced, the notification changes the official ex-depot benchmark for these two fuels, rather than reporting a company-specific development. The rates are relevant to readers tracking fuel prices and the oil and gas marketing sector.
 At a glance
 Petrol’s ex-depot price falls to Rs325.00 per litre from November 18.
 HSD remains unchanged at Rs358.00 per litre.
